result:
I reviewed the actual diff (and the underlying `veridian-ui-kit` package source, not just the worker's self-report) and found a real, reproducible bug: the new right-panel-toggle button added to `AppTopbar`/`layout.tsx` doesn't actually collapse the VeriChatPanel. `AppShellFrame` in `node_modules/@fchecklist/veridian-ui-kit` renders the panel's fixed-width wrapper div and drag handle whenever the route isn't home — regardless of whether the `panel` prop is null — so toggling it "off" just empties the content and leaves a blank ~420px gutter with a live resize handle on all ~40 non-dashboard pages. This is a genuinely new feature (compliance-tracker's proven precedent PR never wired this toggle at all), and PROGRESS.md's claim of "a real working right-panel-toggle" isn't accurate — no browser click-through was recorded, only tsc/lint/build.

The rest of the migration (veri-chat-context.tsx rewrite, AppSidebar/VeriChatPanel chrome adoption, VeriComposer blocker documentation) is careful and faithfully preserves prior behavior. No `.github/workflows/**` changes are present.

I wrote `review-verdict.json` with `"verdict": "reject"`, tier1, and both this issue and a minor disclosure gap (capability-tree now refetches on every top-level nav instead of once per session).
